subject: Acme Corp - SOC 2 & Data Handling Recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <ajohnson@acmecorp.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Acme Corp - SOC 2 & Data Handling Recap

Alex / Sarah -

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone is aligned and we have clear next steps. If I missed anything, please flag.

Summary of pain / goals:
- Primary goal: host sensitive customer data for Acme's AI features while meeting SOC 2 and enterprise data retention requirements.
- Main pain points: lack of consistent audit logs across current serving stack, unclear data retention enforcement, and procurement needing an approved DPA + pen-test evidence for legal.
- Risk tolerance: must be able to provide evidence of access controls, KMS integration, and per-customer retention policies.

What we covered:
- Redwood's SOC 2 scope: infrastructure and controls for hosted inference, routine SOC 2 Type II report (summary attached).
- Audit logs: we emit token-level and request-level logs, immutable storage for a configurable retention window; logs can be exported to your SIEM (Syslog/S3).
- Data retention: per-customer retention policies with automated deletion and optional export prior to deletion.
- DPA / legal: we can provide a DPA draft and sign via DocuSign; procurement asked about liability/retention clauses.
- Pen test evidence: we can share a redacted penetration test summary and remediation timeline; full reports available under NDA.

Action items / next steps (owners & timeline):
1) Marissa (Redwood): Share SOC 2 summary, DPA draft, and pen-test summary - by EOD Tue 12/15. (attachments)
2) Alex (Acme): Confirm procurement contact and priority CLA/contract terms; indicate redlines expected - by Fri 12/18.
3) Neha (Redwood Security): Set up follow-up call to walk technical security team through audit logs & retention (target week of 12/21).
4) David (Redwood Eng): Standby for deeper tech call to discuss KMS/HSM integration and log export formats.

Proposed follow-up: 30-45 minute security deep-dive with your security and infra leads (we recommended week of 12/21). Please share a few time windows that work.

Attachments (attached to this thread): Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2026.pdf, DPA_Draft_Acme_Redwood_v1.docx, pen-test-summary-2026.zip

Thanks - happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

-
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Acme Corp - SOC 2 & Data Handling Recap

Marissa -

Appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Retention windows: we need the ability to set retention at the customer-id level and enforce immediate deletion on contract termination. Can you confirm that deletions are irreversible and that you provide a deletion audit record?
2) Audit logs: can those be pushed to our S3 bucket (us-west-2) and retained for 7 years on our side? Any PII redaction options at export time?
3) Pen test: procurement needs to understand whether you will share the full report under NDA or only a redacted executive summary. What's your standard process?
4) DPA: procurement is flagged on this thread (procurement@acmecorp.com). We prefer to review an editable Word doc for redlines.

We're working on scheduling availability for the security deep-dive - Sarah will propose times.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Product Security
Acme Corp

Subject: Re: Acme Corp - SOC 2 & Data Handling Recap

Alex / Sarah -

Thanks for the quick follow-up and great questions. Short answers below; see attached docs for details.

1) Retention / Deletion: Yes - retention is configurable per-tenant (customer-id). Deletions are irreversible once the deletion job completes; an immutable deletion audit record is generated and stored in your logs. We note the timestamp, initiating principal, and data scope in the audit record. (See section 3.2 in the SOC2 summary.)

2) Audit log export: We support push to S3 (bucket policy-based ingest) and can also stream to SIEMs. Exported logs are raw by default; redaction is supported via a transform layer before export (we can configure PII-hiding rules). We'll include sample schema and retention options in the attachment.

3) Pen test: Standard process - we can share a redacted executive summary by default, and the full report under NDA. The attached pen-test-summary-2026.zip contains the exec summary + remediation tracker; full report available with NDA.

4) DPA: attaching an editable Word draft (DPA_Draft_Acme_Redwood_v1.docx). Procurement, please review and return redlines; we can do a legal-to-legal call if helpful.

Next steps (updated):
- I'll upload the SOC2 summary and DPA to the Deal in HubSpot and send the DocuSign link once we agree on contract terms.
- Neha will run the security deep-dive and loop engineering (David) to cover KMS/HSM specifics.

Proposed windows for the technical deep-dive (30-45m):
- Tue 12/22: 10:00-11:00 PT
- Wed 12/23: 08:30-09:15 PT
- Thu 12/24: 09:00-10:00 PT

Please confirm which works and we'll send a calendar invite.
